cw_host.description: Asio OpenAPI host for your ConnectWise RMM region.

cw_client_id.description: Client ID of the API client created in ConnectWise RMM (Settings > Integrations > API Clients).

cw_client_secret.description: Client secret for the API client above. It has to travel in the token request body, which secure parameters can't be used in, so it is stored as a regular installation parameter.

cw_scope.description: OAuth scopes requested for the API client, space separated. Read and Update are required (Platform - Tickets - Read / Update). Add platform.companies.read to include company names on imported tickets.

fs_api_key.description: API key of the agent the app acts as (Profile settings > API key).

close_after_import.display_name: Close tickets in ConnectWise RMM after import
close_after_import.description: When on, a ConnectWise ticket is set to Closed once its Freshservice ticket has been created, and Freshservice becomes the place to work it. Resolutions in ConnectWise only sync to Freshservice for tickets left open.

resolve_sync.display_name: Resolve Freshservice tickets when resolved in ConnectWise RMM

poll_interval_minutes.description: How often to pull new tickets from ConnectWise RMM.

default_requester_email.description: Requester for imported tickets that have no contact email in ConnectWise RMM.

fs_group_id.description: Assign imported tickets to this agent group.

webhook_secret.description: If set, events posted to the app's external event URL must send this value in an X-Webhook-Secret header or a "secret" body field.
